statutory_trace: ITAA 1936 s 109E(1): a private company is taken to pay a dividend at the end of the current year where an amalgamated loan made in an earlier year is not repaid and payments fall short of the minimum yearly repayment.
s 109E(5): the minimum yearly repayment is worked out using the formula in s 109E(6).

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 100000.00.
Current year's benchmark interest rate (2026-27, s 109N(2)) = 0.0877, from RBA table F5 series FILRHLBVS, 2026-05 figure.
Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 5.
MYR = (100000.00 x 0.0877) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0877)) ^ 5) = 25556.00 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 25556.00.

s 109E(5): the minimum yearly repayment is worked out using the formula in s 109E(6).

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 100000.00.
Current year's benchmark interest rate (2026-27, s 109N(2)) = 0.0877, from RBA table F5 series FILRHLBVS, 2026-05 figure.
Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 5.
MYR = (100000.00 x 0.0877) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0877)) ^ 5) = 25556.00 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 40000.00.

statutory_trace: ITAA 1936 s 109E(1): a private company is taken to pay a dividend at the end of the current year where an amalgamated loan made in an earlier year is not repaid and payments fall short of the minimum yearly repayment.
s 109E(5): the minimum yearly repayment is worked out using the formula in s 109E(6).

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 100000.00.
Current year's benchmark interest rate (2026-27, s 109N(2)) = 0.0877, from RBA table F5 series FILRHLBVS, 2026-05 figure.
Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 5.
MYR = (100000.00 x 0.0877) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0877)) ^ 5) = 25556.00 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 25556.00.

Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 25556.00.

caveats: s 109R: this engine did not decide whether the payments applied are genuine repayments. A payment made where the borrower intended to draw a similar or larger loan is left out of the reckoning by s 109R(2), and that turns on what a reasonable person would conclude. The figure used is the operator's assertion.

Any shortfall shown is an experimental review aid, not an ATO assessment and not a s 109E(1) determination. s 109E(2) makes the dividend the shortfall subject to s 109Y, which caps Division 7A dividends at the company's distributable surplus, and s 109E(1)(d) removes the dividend where s 109Q applies. Neither is modelled here, and neither is s 109RB.

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 1000000000000.00.
Current year's benchmark interest rate (2026-27, s 109N(2)) = 0.0877, from RBA table F5 series FILRHLBVS, 2026-05 figure.
Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 1E+999999999.
MYR = (1000000000000.00 x 0.0877) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0877)) ^ 1E+999999999) = 87700000000.00 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 0.00.

statutory_trace: ITAA 1936 s 109E(1): a private company is taken to pay a dividend at the end of the current year where an amalgamated loan made in an earlier year is not repaid and payments fall short of the minimum yearly repayment.
s 109E(5): the minimum yearly repayment is worked out using the formula in s 109E(6).

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 1000000000000.00.
Current year's benchmark interest rate (2026-27, s 109N(2)) = 0.0877, from RBA table F5 series FILRHLBVS, 2026-05 figure.
Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 4.
MYR = (1000000000000.00 x 0.0877) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0877)) ^ 4) = 307111815954.34 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 0.00.

MYR = (0.00 x 0.0837) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0837)) ^ 1E+10) = 0.00 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 0.00.

statutory_trace: ITAA 1936 s 109E(1): a private company is taken to pay a dividend at the end of the current year where an amalgamated loan made in an earlier year is not repaid and payments fall short of the minimum yearly repayment.
s 109E(5): the minimum yearly repayment is worked out using the formula in s 109E(6).

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 575073514054.77.
Current year's benchmark interest rate (2025-26, s 109N(2)) = 0.0837, from RBA table F5 series FILRHLBVS, 2025-05 figure.
Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 4.
MYR = (575073514054.77 x 0.0837) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0837)) ^ 4) = 175058777703.66 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 0.00.

s 109E(5): the minimum yearly repayment is worked out using the formula in s 109E(6).

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 0.00.
Current year's benchmark interest rate (2025-26, s 109N(2)) = 0.0837, from RBA table F5 series FILRHLBVS, 2025-05 figure.
Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 1E+70.
MYR = (0.00 x 0.0837) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0837)) ^ 1E+70) = 0.00 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 4560806.19.

statutory_trace: ITAA 1936 s 109E(1): a private company is taken to pay a dividend at the end of the current year where an amalgamated loan made in an earlier year is not repaid and payments fall short of the minimum yearly repayment.
s 109E(5): the minimum yearly repayment is worked out using the formula in s 109E(6).

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 1000000000000.00.
Current year's benchmark interest rate (2024-25, s 109N(2)) = 0.0877, from RBA table F5 series FILRHLBVS, 2024-05 figure.
Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 22.
MYR = (1000000000000.00 x 0.0877) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0877)) ^ 22) = 104073401943.45 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 0.00.

s 109E(5): the minimum yearly repayment is worked out using the formula in s 109E(6).

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 1000000000000.00.

Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 1E+999999999.
MYR = (1000000000000.00 x 0.0877) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0877)) ^ 1E+999999999) = 87700000000.00 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 0.00.

s 109E(5): the minimum yearly repayment is worked out using the formula in s 109E(6).

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 0.00.
Current year's benchmark interest rate (2024-25, s 109N(2)) = 0.0877, from RBA table F5 series FILRHLBVS, 2024-05 figure.
Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 1.
MYR = (0.00 x 0.0877) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0877)) ^ 1) = 0.00 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 0.00.

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).

Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 30.
MYR = (0.00 x 0.0877) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0877)) ^ 30) = 0.00 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).

s 109E(5): the minimum yearly repayment is worked out using the formula in s 109E(6).

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 1000000000000.00.

statutory_trace: ITAA 1936 s 109E(1): a private company is taken to pay a dividend at the end of the current year where an amalgamated loan made in an earlier year is not repaid and payments fall short of the minimum yearly repayment.
s 109E(5): the minimum yearly repayment is worked out using the formula in s 109E(6).

s 109E(6) formula: MYR = (amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income x current year's benchmark interest rate) / (1 - (1 / (1 + current year's benchmark interest rate)) ^ remaining term).
Amount of the loan not repaid by the end of the previous year of income = 68354493386.42.
Current year's benchmark interest rate (2026-27, s 109N(2)) = 0.0877, from RBA table F5 series FILRHLBVS, 2026-05 figure.
Remaining term (s 109E(6), rounded up to a whole number) = 3.
MYR = (68354493386.42 x 0.0877) / (1 - (1 / (1 + 0.0877)) ^ 3) = 26893146759.85 (quantised to cents, ROUND_HALF_UP; the Act prescribes no rounding).
Payments applied during the year (operator assertion, s 109R not applied) = 0.00.

The figure used is the operator's assertion.

Any shortfall shown is an experimental review aid, not an ATO assessment and not a s 109E(1) determination. s 109E(2) makes the dividend the shortfall subject to s 109Y, which caps Division 7A dividends at the company's distributable surplus, and s 109E(1)(d) removes the dividend where s 109Q applies. Neither is modelled here, and neither is s 109RB.
